datasets.title: Differential expression of miRNAs in a cellular model of MELAS.
datasets.summary: We investigate the participation of miRNAs in the cell response to the mitochondrial dysfunction associated with m.3243A>G mutation in mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which is the most common cause of MELAS (mitochondrial encephalomyopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes) syndrome.Through small-RNA sequencing and in silico analysis, we identified 246 differentially-expressed in a transmitochondrial cybrid model of MELAS (100% m.3243A>G mutant mitochondrial DNA), with 126 being up-regulated and 120 down-regulated. The enrichment analysis of Gene Ontology (GO) terms revealed that target genes for dysregulated miRNAs were involved in muscle and nervous system development, heart development, and signaling pathways controlling cardiac events.These data suggest that the miRNA program triggered by the MELAS m.3243A>G mutation could explain for some of the clinical manifestations of the MELAS syndrome.
datasets.overall_design: Examination of dysregulated miRNAs in MELAS.
datasets.study_design: MELAS突变与野生型cybrid细胞模型，small RNA-seq差异miRNA分析

evidence.relevant: MELAS是线粒体肌病的亚型，样本为携带致病突变m.3243A>G的cybrid细胞模型
evidence.sequencing_type: 摘要明确为small-RNA sequencing研究miRNA，GEO数据类型为Non-coding RNA profiling by HTS，总RNA经小RNA富集后HiSeq测序，属bulk miRNA-seq
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为骨肉瘤143B细胞来源的cybrids，非人类患者，无生存时间/状态字段
evidence.treatment: 核心比较是野生型vs突变型mtDNA，无药物/干预对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 表达平台但对照为同细胞背景的野生型基因型，非独立真健康个体
evidence.correlation: 表达平台但仅有6个细胞系样本，无患者疾病样本，无法做相关性
evidence.sample_source: 所有样本均为已建系的骨肉瘤143B细胞（osteosarcoma 143B）来源的线粒体转胞质杂交（cybrid）细胞，体外培养后直接提取总RNA测序，属于永生化细胞系模型。

datasets.summary: To elucidate the regulating networks of dysregulated ncRNAs in Mitochondrial myopathy, Encephalopathy, Lactic Acidosis, and Stroke-like episodes (MELAS) with m.A3243G mutation.
datasets.overall_design: The MELAS sample consisted of a muscle pool from 20 MELAS patients with m.A3243G mutation, and the Control sample consisted of a muscle pool from 20 healthy controls. LncRNA sequencing and miRNA array of muscle pools were performed by the service provider (LC Sciences). The secondary qRT-PCR validation of the most promising miRNAs and lncRNAs using individual samples were from the same group. The findings were all consistent with results from our high-throughput data.
